# awscc_transcribe_call_analytics_category (Resource)

Resource type definition for AWS::Transcribe::CallAnalyticsCategory



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category_name` (String) A unique name, chosen by you, for your Call Analytics category.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules define a Call Analytics category. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `input_type` (String) The input type associated with the specified category.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags associated with the Call Analytics category. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Call Analytics category.
- `create_time` (String) The date and time the Call Analytics category was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_update_time` (String) The date and time the Call Analytics category was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_transcribe_call_analytics_category.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Call Analytics category

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_transcribe_call_analytics_category.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_transcribe_call_analytics_category.example "arn"
```
